name: menthol + white petrolatum + zinc oxide
uses: Uses ■ gives temporary relief of local itching and discomfort in the perianal area ■ temporarily forms a protective coating over inflamed tissues to help prevent drying of tissues ■ temporarily protects irritated areas ■ temporarily relieves burning ■ provides temporary relief from skin irritations ■ temporarily protects the inflamed, irritated anorectal surface to help make bowel movements less painful ■ temporarily protects inflamed perianal skin ■ temporarily relieves the symptoms of perianal skin irritation ■ may provide a cooling sensation
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if ■ condition worsens or does not improve in 7 days ■ bleeding occurs, consult a doctor promptly

src.label: Zinc Oxide with Menthol and White Petrolatum
